# Apilio

Apilio is a home automation platform that enables users to connect and control smart devices from various brands, offering flexible automation through complex conditions, time constraints, and integrations with services like IFTTT and Tuya.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/apilio/.

## Actions

- **Get Boolean Variables** (read-only): Fetch all boolean variables.
- **Get Conditions** (read-only): Fetch all evaluatable conditions.
- **Get Logicblocks** (read-only): Fetch all logicblocks of a user.
- **Get Numeric Variables** (read-only): Fetch all numeric variables.
- **Get String Variables** (read-only): Fetch all string variables.
